commitments.detail: One patient to receive the portable negative-pressure wound-therapy unit.
The portable unit can support one patient at a time after discharge.
Assign the single portable negative-pressure wound-therapy unit to one patient upon discharge.
Conduct a huddle with wound care, infectious disease, durable medical equipment, and home health before finalizing allocation.
Assign the only portable negative-pressure wound-therapy unit to one patient upon discharge.
Document the care plan for both patients.
